LightningComponentBundle.description: Make an exact copy of this record, including copies of the records it looks up to. Master records, users and groups stay linked to the originals.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title displayed at the top of the component.

property.name: linkedObjects
property.label: Objects to link instead of copy
property.description: Comma separated object API names. Lookups to these objects point at the original record instead of a copy. Users, groups and master records are always linked.

property.name: maxDepth
property.label: Copy depth limit
property.description: How many levels of lookups to copy. 0 copies only this record, 1 also copies the records it looks up to, and so on. Leave blank for no limit.

property.name: showPreview
property.label: Show preview
property.description: List the records that will be copied and the lookups that stay linked before copying.
